id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_050.pack|cs_:
"Im-impossible...!! I, who rule even time,
  defeated by such worms...!!

"But if I'm to fall like this, I'll destroy
  time along with this body and
  wipe out the world!

"What power! If that power is released,
  the world will really be destroyed!
"Damn, what do we do...!!
"Just kidding! It was a lie, boing!

"Ha ha ha! Sorry, sorry!
  Did I startle you?

"Relax! That was a total lie!
  I never meant to destroy the world!
  It was just a little joke!

"Besides, I'm no destroyer of time.
  I'm the Friend of Time, a great god
  who watches over Erdrea's flow of time.

"A guardian god watching over time...
  Then why did you fight us?

"To test whether you have the power
  to defeat the evil god Calasmos.

"He and I are both gods.
  As a fellow god, I couldn't just
  watch him do evil.

"So I thought of how to chastise him,
  and picked {var:1}, the Luminary
  born with him in this world.

"I damaged the Logs and warped history
  only to test if you could
  defeat the evil god.

"I apologize for the rough method of damaging
  the Logs, but it was all I could think of...

"But you not only restored every Log,
  you even defeated me!
  Truly splendid!

"Acknowledging you as a worthy Luminary,
  I'll raise a statue of you in the altar room
  of Tickington, like the past heroes.
"...Still, memory is a strange thing.

"Even if time gone by never returns,
  memories are passed down forever
  as threads weaving the world...

"The memories of past heroes you set right
  and of your own adventure are
  precious threads weaving the world.

"However hard things get, those precious
  memories will surely support
  your future.

"Now, enough talk. Let me send you
  back to Tickington.
"Oh, Hero, welcome back, tchi!

"What! The Adventure Logs were tattered
  by the Friend of Time himself!?

"The Friend of Time is said to have given
  us Tockles the mission of passing on
  heroes' feats long ago...

"That he deliberately damaged the Logs
  must have been for a deeper reason...

"But I am truly grateful!
  Thanks to you, the Tockles' mission
  is safely fulfilled!

"Well, Hero. We can't keep you in the village
  any longer. This is farewell, but...
"Wait a moment, tchi!

"Sudden, but I have a favor, Hero, tchi!
  I want to see more of Erdrea,
  where you live, tchi! So...

"Please take me along as your companion,
  tchi! I'm begging you, tchi!

"Whaaat? No way, tchi! The Hero
  wouldn't say that, tchi!
  I'll ask again, tchi!

"Yay, tchi! I knew the Hero
  would say yes, tchi!

"I have items I can use in battle,
  so I'll definitely be useful, tchi!
  Pleased to meet you, tchi!

"Thank you for hearing out
  Kurutchi's sudden request.

"He's a bit of a handful, but it's a good
  chance. Please take him to many places
  and show him the wide world.

"Well, Hero. This is farewell.
  You are a hero of Tickington.

"Visit anytime you have a moment.
  Everyone will welcome you.
